subject: Problem with package path with rStudio on server

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Problem with package path with rStudio on server
parts:
Hi
  I have a website with several packages which I uploaded via the terminal and reside in
"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library"  

I recently installed rStudio which makes managing packages easier. The 
packages installed since go into a different folder
"/home/rstudio/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.0"

although the install packages has a drop down to choose a library location
only the latter option is shown

when I run 
> .libPaths()
[1] "/home/rstudio/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.0"
[2] "/usr/local/lib/R/site-library"                  
[3] "/usr/lib/R/site-library"                        
[4] "/usr/lib/R/library"

it suggest this should not matter

However, when I run an app on the website which uses library(httr) a package which resides in the 
"/home/rstudio/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.0" library I get a console error of
Error : could not find function "GET"

In rstudio library(httr) loads without issue

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Problem with package path with rStudio on server
parts:
You are strongly recommended to install packages to the system-wide
library path (any one under /usr/) instead of a user's personal
library (the one under /home/). A system-wide library is shared across
all users in the OS, so its packages are guaranteed to be available.
That is not true for a personal library. You either chmod on
"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library" or run R via sudo, then install to
this library.

Regards,
Yihui
